ordering.records: ascending ID using ordinal string order

identifiers_and_paths.patient_id_reason: no patient identifier is supplied and Case is not locally documented as a patient identifier
identifiers_and_paths.case_id: decimal string form of Case, required because the canonical schema requires a string or null

join_and_grouping.table_to_mask: replace only the leading bus_ in ID with mask_; measured one-to-one (1,875/1,875)
join_and_grouping.fold_tables: exact ID joins; both measured one-to-one (1,875/1,875), with Pathology agreeing on every row
join_and_grouping.output_grouping: one output record per bus_data.csv row/image; rows sharing Case are not merged

unresolved_decisions.question: Should BBOX remain an exact source string, or can a documented coordinate convention be supplied so it can be mapped to a numeric bbox?
unresolved_decisions.proposed_resolution: Keep BBOX as bbox_source string because no local source defines its coordinate convention.

unresolved_decisions.question: Should the 5-fold and 10-fold experimental split metadata remain excluded from benchmark annotations?
unresolved_decisions.proposed_resolution: Yes. Exclude it because it is experimental partition metadata rather than a medical fact.
